description: Mr. Swadeep started a trading business 'Barrackpore Traders' with cash capital ₹8,00,000.
narration: Being initial capital introduced in cash by Mr. Swadeep.
explanation: Cash asset increases (Debit Cash). Capital equity increases (Credit Capital).

description: Opened current bank account with HDFC Bank by depositing ₹5,00,000 cash.
narration: Being cash deposited into HDFC Bank current account.
explanation: Bank asset increases (Debit Bank). Cash asset decreases (Credit Cash).

description: Purchased office furniture for ₹50,000 by HDFC Bank cheque.
narration: Being office furniture purchased via HDFC cheque No 100201.
explanation: Furniture asset increases (Debit Furniture). Bank asset decreases (Credit HDFC Bank).

description: Purchased trading stock for cash ₹75,000.
narration: Being trading goods purchased for cash.
explanation: Purchase expense increases (Debit Purchase). Cash asset decreases (Credit Cash).

description: Purchased goods on credit from M/s Kolkata Electricals for ₹1,80,000.
narration: Being goods purchased on credit from M/s Kolkata Electricals vide Bill No KE-901.
explanation: Purchase cost increases (Debit Purchase). Supplier creditor liability increases (Credit Kolkata Electricals).

description: Paid transport carriage inward ₹3,500 cash on goods purchased.
narration: Being carriage inward freight paid in cash for goods purchase.
explanation: Direct freight expense increases (Debit Carriage Inward). Cash asset decreases (Credit Cash).

description: Sold trading goods for cash ₹1,10,000.
narration: Being trading goods sold for cash.
explanation: Cash asset increases (Debit Cash). Sales revenue income increases (Credit Sales).

description: Sold goods on credit to M/s Suburban Retailers for ₹2,40,000.
narration: Being goods sold on credit to M/s Suburban Retailers vide Invoice No INV-101.
explanation: Debtor customer asset increases (Debit Suburban Retailers). Sales revenue increases (Credit Sales).

description: Returned damaged goods worth ₹15,000 to M/s Kolkata Electricals.
narration: Being damaged goods returned to supplier Kolkata Electricals vide Debit Note DN-01.
explanation: Creditor vendor liability decreases (Debit Kolkata Electricals). Purchase return reduces cost (Credit Purchase Return).

description: M/s Suburban Retailers returned goods worth ₹10,000.
narration: Being goods returned by customer Suburban Retailers vide Credit Note CN-01.
explanation: Sales return reduces sales turnover (Debit Sales Return). Customer debtor balance decreases (Credit Suburban Retailers).

description: Paid ₹1,55,000 by HDFC bank NEFT to Kolkata Electricals in full settlement after ₹10,000 cash discount.
narration: Being full settlement paid to Kolkata Electricals after cash discount.
explanation: Vendor liability cleared ₹1,65,000. Bank decreases by ₹1,55,000. Discount gain earned ₹10,000.

description: Received ₹2,20,000 cheque from Suburban Retailers after allowing ₹10,000 cash discount.
narration: Being cheque received from Suburban Retailers in settlement after cash discount.
explanation: Bank asset increases by ₹2,20,000. Discount allowed expense debited ₹10,000. Customer debtor balance cleared ₹2,30,000.

description: Paid shop rent ₹22,000 and electricity bill ₹8,500 cash.
narration: Being shop rent and electricity bill paid in cash (Compound Payment).
explanation: Compound entry debiting Rent (₹22,000) and Electricity (₹8,500), crediting Cash (₹30,500).

description: Paid monthly staff salary ₹45,000 via HDFC bank transfer.
narration: Being monthly staff salaries paid via bank transfer for April 2026.
explanation: Salary expense increases (Debit Salary). Bank asset decreases (Credit HDFC Bank).

description: Proprietor Swadeep withdrew ₹15,000 cash for personal household expenses.
narration: Being cash withdrawn by proprietor for personal house use.
explanation: Drawings reduces capital equity (Debit Drawings). Cash asset decreases (Credit Cash).

description: Proprietor took goods costing ₹6,000 for personal family use.
narration: Being goods taken by proprietor for personal use at cost price.
explanation: Goods taken for personal use reduce Purchase stock cost (Credit Purchase A/c) at cost price.

description: Distributed goods costing ₹4,000 as free samples for marketing.
narration: Being goods distributed as free samples for market promotion.
explanation: Sample distribution is a promotional marketing expense (Debit Advertisement) reducing Purchase cost (Credit Purchase).

description: Paid annual trade fire insurance premium ₹18,000 via HDFC bank cheque.
narration: Being shop fire insurance premium paid via cheque.
explanation: Insurance expense debited (Debit Insurance Premium). Bank asset credited (Credit HDFC Bank).

description: Purchased office computer system for ₹35,000 cash.
narration: Being office computer desktop purchased for admin billing.
explanation: Fixed asset increases (Debit Computer System). Cash asset decreases (Credit Cash).

description: Received ₹12,000 cash as commission income.
narration: Being trade agency commission received in cash.
explanation: Cash asset increases (Debit Cash). Indirect income increases (Credit Commission Received).

description: HDFC Bank debited ₹650 as quarterly account maintenance charges.
narration: Being bank charges debited by HDFC Bank.
explanation: Operating expense debited (Debit Bank Charges). Bank balance reduced (Credit HDFC Bank).

description: Customer 'Tuhina Sen' became bankrupt; her total debt of ₹20,000 written off as Bad Debt.
narration: Being insolvent debtor balance written off as Bad Debt in F7 Journal.
explanation: Uncollectible debt is an operating loss (Debit Bad Debts). Customer debtor balance cleared (Credit Tuhina Sen).

description: Previously written-off customer Tuhina Sen paid ₹8,000 cash back.
narration: Being cash recovered from previously written-off debtor Tuhina Sen.
explanation: Cash asset increases (Debit Cash). Non-operating gain credited (Credit Bad Debts Recovered).

description: Depreciation of ₹6,000 charged on office computer and furniture.
narration: Being monthly depreciation charged on office assets.
explanation: Non-cash operating expense debited (Debit Depreciation). Fixed asset book value reduced (Credit Assets).

description: Accrued interest of ₹4,000 on fixed deposit recognized at month-end.
narration: Being accrued interest income recognized on bank FD at month-end.
explanation: Accrual concept creates current receivable asset (Debit Accrued Interest) and recognizes income (Credit Interest Income).
